confidence_notes: A June 2026 search snapshot of [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Gothenburg) informs the meal, coffee and beer estimates. Cocktail and wine estimates use a [Gothenburg travel guide](https://www.nomadicmatt.com/travel-guides/sweden-travel-tips/gothenburg/) and their price relationship to beer. Accommodation estimates are holistic and less certain, particularly around July events.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates reflect Swedish city costs and summer tourism demand, with Stockholm as a generally higher-cost reference.
